purpose: Express a determined purpose in a literary style.
keywords: Vない stem + んがために / の; する → せんがため
I took up my pen in order to tell the truth.
She trained repeatedly to master her craft.
This is not an action taken to leave a name behind.
formation: Vない stem + んがために / の; する → せんがため
restrictions: Typically a deliberate effort toward an important goal.
mistake: It is a purpose construction, not a causal explanation.
